headline: Lula Secures Victory in Brazil Presidential Runoff as Opponent Rejects Result
summary: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won the Brazilian presidential runoff election, leading by nearly 4.4 million votes, while opponent Flávio Bolsonaro rejected the results.
why: Brazil is Latin America's largest economy, and its political leadership significantly affects regional trade, fiscal policy, and international investor confidence.

impacts.name: iShares MSCI Brazil ETF
impacts.why: Contested election results and political uncertainty in Brazil typically trigger sell-offs in local equities and exchange-traded funds.

why_moved: Contested election outcomes create political instability, driving foreign investors to divest from Brazilian assets amid fears of prolonged legal and social friction.
